criteria.text:
Restrict local media access to owned storage
Report rows: 01. Confine local reads/deletes to configured storage; reject traversal, symlink escapes, foreign/deleted Media and invalid save-media object names. Preserve normal uploads.
Acceptance: Real filesystem tests cover traversal, symlinks, ownership, deletion and valid media.

Carry cover and alt settings through providers
Report rows: 12. Reuse existing media fields and select owned library covers or timestamps. Carry supported settings through providers; optional cover failure preserves confirmed publication receipt.
Acceptance: Provider payloads and UI ownership/unsupported settings checks pass; existing YouTube thumbnail receipt regression remains green.

Filter calendar and lists by multiple channels
Report rows: 14. Add integrationIds server filtering and multiselect with pagination; retain project/editorial/date/state filters and old integrationId compatibility.
Acceptance: Multi/single/empty selections, pagination and filter combinations work with accessible controls.

Add local channel aliases and group rename
Report rows: 15. Persist optional displayName independently from provider name; use one label helper, reset alias and preserve it on reconnect. Reuse existing group menu; no platform rename requests.
Acceptance: Alias fallback/reset/reconnect, organization scoping and existing group rename behavior pass.

Support media upload and attachment metadata through MCP
Report rows: 16. Extend shared capabilities with upload widget/ticket/status, owned media metadata and previewUrl. Binary goes through uploader, never model arguments. Preserve OAuth/policies/confirmations and manual fallback.
Acceptance: Controlled SDK/widget flow covers upload/status/attach/preview, foreign/deleted ids, authorization and clients without widget support.

Stream media through bounded SSRF-safe reads
Report rows: 02,09. Use one safe media reader with DNS/redirect guards, byte limits, deadlines and cancellation. Stream large LinkedIn/X transfers; buffer only bounded image transforms.
Acceptance: Stalled body, redirect/private addresses, abort, truncated/large stream tests pass without buffering the entire video.

Correct VK endpoints and publication receipts
Report rows: 04. Adopt selected VK domain and response corrections for photos, videos and wall.post. Never report success without a confirmed provider identifier.
Acceptance: Controlled photo/video/wall.post success and failure responses give truthful receipts.

Update Meta Graph requests and provider corrections
Report rows: 05,13-Meta. Use shared Graph API v25.0 constant; verify affected official methods. Adapt carousel collaborator and video_insights corrections without changing auth routes or permissions.
Acceptance: Request-contract and error tests cover Facebook/Instagram routes, carousels and analytics; unsupported observations remain unavailable.

Expose actionable provider failure categories
Report rows: 06. Classify Telegram/VK/Meta/YouTube content, permissions, reconnect, safe retry and unknown outcome consistently across calendar/API/agent results. Keep sensitive raw responses out.
Acceptance: Representative failures have actionable localized diagnostics; unknown outcome never enables resend; redaction regressions pass.

Add versioned publication heartbeat and recovery
Report rows: 08. Add a new post workflow/activity after V109, with heartbeat stage diagnostics. Route new starts to it while preserving all existing workflow/activity contracts and durable publication semantics.
Acceptance: Controlled worker loss before send, after send and after receipt causes no duplicate; old contracts and running jobs remain compatible.

Correct Pinterest analytics and LinkedIn company access
Report rows: 13. Use Pinterest summary_metrics and selected LinkedIn company/content-admin access corrections. Keep source provenance and distinguish unavailable from zero; Meta portion belongs to T4.
Acceptance: Fixture responses verify supported metrics, missing data and personal/company identity isolation.

Add versioned anchored preview discussions
Report rows: 11-team. Add text anchors, replies, resolve/reopen to existing preview; retain quote and source revision, mark changed anchors explicitly. Keep legacy Comments/userId and display old comments unanchored.
Acceptance: Real service/database and UI tests cover thread/reply/resolve, changed text, legacy comments and two-tenant isolation.

Add revocable scoped guest preview access
Report rows: 11-guest. Issue hashed 7-day scoped guest grants for one current preview and attachments; guests comment/reply only. Require member auth or valid grant on legacy preview/comment routes. Support revoke/reissue and label guest identity unverified.
Acceptance: Expired/revoked/foreign grants and anonymous legacy URLs are refused; current text and anchored discussion work; no editing, resolving or publication authority leaks.
